name: Teen Volunteers (Meridian Library District)
what_you_do: Help the library with holds, events and the summer reading program. Teens fill out a volunteer form on the library's volunteer system.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 12 or older. Anyone under 18 needs permission from a parent or legal guardian. An older library event page lists the teen program as ages 12 to 18, grades 7 to 12.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The library lists volunteer opportunities all year on its volunteer system.
how_to_apply: See the volunteer page. Use the Volunteer Opportunities link (Volgistics). Email volunteer@mld.org. Ask about teen jobs and when orientation is.
notes: The main volunteer page does not describe a teen program. The 2020 teen event page gives the phone number (208) 472-1755. It also gives the teen steps: a flyer, a Teen Volunteer Form and orientation. Ask volunteer@mld.org to confirm the current steps.
